title: Android month-cell semantics consolidation confirmation
scope: Android UI fixture paging only; not database, network, or write throughput; no FPS claim.

comparison_provenance.baseline: Accepted bounded-preview V1 APKs from the prior month-cells iteration.
comparison_provenance.candidate: V3 month-cell semantics candidate evaluated in this separate confirmation suite.
comparison_provenance.causal_scope: Only contemporaneous paired V3 confirmation captures are compared. The separate six-capture exploratory screen and historical readiness/council traces are excluded from paired and causal estimates.

evaluation_plan.scope: V3 Android confirmation: accepted V1 bounded-preview baseline versus V3 semantics/month-cell candidate; UI fixture paging only.
evaluation_plan.baseline: Accepted bounded-preview APKs from captures/performance/month-cells/after; not the original readiness baseline.
evaluation_plan.candidate: Frozen V3 semantics candidate APKs under month-cells-v3/after.
evaluation_plan.ordering: Interleaved before/after pairs with order alternation; binaries, fixture inputs, runner and query signatures frozen before confirmation.
controls: Same full-year fixture data and loading policy per paired profile.
Compile each installed APK with package compile -f -m speed; record checks before install and after compile.
No concurrent host builds during the confirmation captures.
Preserve all errors, trace outliers, and temperature/thermal observations.

prospective_review_criteria.paired_consistency: Strong paired improvement across the steady-month, steady-forward, and loading profiles; evaluate paired per-run deltas, not pooled CPU.
prospective_review_criteria.regressions: No consistent p95 or late-frame regression; no worsened recurring >=40ms or >=50ms tails.
prospective_review_criteria.p99: Desirable improvement; report and review as a tail metric.

evaluation_plan.criterion_status: Prospective review criteria, not a guaranteed score or automatic pass/fail result.
evaluation_plan.exploratory_exclusion: month-cells-v3/exploratory contains a separate six-capture n=1 diagnostic and is excluded entirely from the 40 confirmation captures, summaries, and paired estimates.
evaluation_plan.causal_scope: Only these contemporaneous before/after confirmation pairs support comparative attribution. Older readiness/council traces are contextual only.

talkback.actual_input: Android UHID external keyboard, Meta+Right and Meta+Space; SpeechController speaking-fragment logs
verified: one focus per day in sampled empty/populated sequence
full visible titles, date, totals, omissions
visible refreshed title on reread using separate QA fixture
compact today counts and Today marker
normal Tab then Enter opens Jan8
talkback.limitation: Physical finger double-tap not tested; keyboard exercises actual TalkBack activation action

notes: Frame p95/p99/max are per-run frame durations; late-frame percentage comes from matched FrameTimeline deadlines.
PSS is one end-of-workload dumpsys meminfo snapshot per run, not a time series.
Memory PSS and main/RenderThread CPU are paired by repetition; CPU totals cover the full recorded trace.
Page-work and composable slice durations are inclusive and can overlap; nested durations are not summed across rows or composables.
Loading marker overlap reports timestamp coincidence with swipe intervals only; it makes no FPS or per-frame causality claim.
Thermal start/end states are retained as conditions; nonzero statuses should be considered when interpreting paired changes.

candidate_only_ge_50ms_stalls.interpretation: A candidate-only duration occurrence is a paired count comparison, not evidence that month-cell work caused the frame.

gesture_window_analysis.scope: Command-window plus 500 ms settling proxy; not exact gesture attribution or FPS.
notes: Frame timestamps are converted to epoch seconds using the nearest preceding REALTIME clock_snapshot offset.
Frames are selected by start time in the union of swipe command windows plus 500 ms settling; duplicates are removed with EXISTS.
Each run also retains every full-trace app surface frame >=40 ms with window, nearby marker/swipe, and owner measure/layout overlap context.
Owner measure/layout overlap is contextual timing evidence only and is not causal attribution.
Frame durations and deadline overruns are unmodified and are not clipped to window edges.
Long-frame rate is count per minute of unioned command-plus-settling exposure, not wall-clock FPS.
Metrics are FrameTimeline samples in the selected proxy windows, not FPS or precise gesture-only measures.
Interaction-window main/RenderThread CPU sums scheduler running time clipped to the union of swipe command plus settling windows; this is CPU time, not FPS.

startup.scope: Android cold process startup; five interleaved pairs; not part of the paging 40-capture suite
startup.interpretation: One am start -S -W cold-process TotalTime per capture; startup values are paired and interleaved. This is an Android startup diagnostic, not paging interaction performance.

manual_cooling_intervention.when: After pair 3, during the before-install cooling guard
manual_cooling_intervention.action: Force-stopped the idle benchmark package; no timed start was active
manual_cooling_intervention.reason: The benchmark remained foreground while device temperature exceeded the cooling threshold

validation.decision: V3 remains rejected because of recurring loading stalls; startup result does not change council scores
